skills.name: core-meeting-capture
skills.description: Use when capturing, refreshing or publishing a meeting, transcript, chat, recording or meeting recap; when a capture README is only a receipt; or when slides, diagrams, whiteboards or demos mentioned in a meeting need visual evidence. Not for recording an ongoing livestream or generating illustrations.

skills.name: book-fetch
skills.description: Search for ebooks on libgen, download EPUBs, and optionally deliver them to an e-reader or Calibre library. Infrastructure-agnostic — discovers the user's setup at runtime.

skills.name: design
skills.description: Design and build production-grade frontend interfaces from scratch. Covers the full workflow from context gathering through visual direction, implementation, and polish.

skills.name: dragon-hunt
skills.description: Run an adversarial end-to-end bug hunt across product, backend, auth, data, integrations, MCP/agent surfaces, and deployment assumptions. Find, prove, fix, test, and log every reachable defect before declaring a system ready.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

skills.name: linkedin-profile
skills.description: Author and publish a complete LinkedIn profile that reads like the operator, not like a model: goal, audience model, verbatim voice capture, fold-first drafting, section-by-section locks (About, Headline, Experience, Featured, Skills, small fields), browser publishing with character-level verification, then a rubric audit loop. Invoke when the user asks to refresh, rewrite, audit, or fix their LinkedIn profile or any section of it. Do NOT invoke for LinkedIn posts/content strategy, or for resumes (different artifact, different rules).

skills.name: product-cloner
skills.description: Clone the look, feel, and behavior of an existing application (especially desktop, Electron, or web apps) by reading its shipped source as ground truth instead of guessing. Use when the user says make X look or behave exactly like Y, clone Typora or Notion or Linear, or pushes back that a parity attempt does not match. Covers locating the source of truth (app bundle CSS and JS, plists, defaults read, beautified minified bundles, the DOM template), pinning the user's active variant, extracting a complete source-grounded spec (visual tokens, DOM and feature inventory, behavior defaults, string inventory), implementing against the spec, and verifying against the reference. Keeps the IP line clear by reading shipped artifacts to extract facts and reimplementing originally.

skills.name: seo-titles
skills.description: Write HTML title tags that rank AND get clicked. Marketing message first, SEO element second.

skills.name: skill-management
skills.description: Browse, install, update, and contribute skills from the ouroboros-skills shared repository. This is the bootstrap skill that teaches agents how to manage their skill library.

skills.name: video-editing
skills.description: Build and edit videos using Remotion with kinetic typography, VO-synced timing, and motion design. Use this skill when the user asks to create, edit, or fix video content.

skills.name: word-docs
skills.description: Convert markdown drafts into shareable Word documents using a bundled helper script.

skills.name: ouro-check
skills.description: Check whether a site, a built app or a page looks, reads and moves right (design, layout, pictures, accessibility, jank, HTTPS) at phone, laptop and 4K sizes in light and dark, from JSON findings instead of screenshots or recordings.
